body.p: Crow (waʼk) and Crab argued. Crow said to Crab: "What are you going to do [in order to die the right way]?" Crab said: "You wait here. This is what we people should do [in order to die the right way]." She went into a hole. She stayed there changing her shell. She made a new shell. She threw the old one away.

Crow was there waiting. He went to search for Crab. He looked in the hole. He said: "This way takes too long. It takes too long to get strong this way." He went back to the waiting-place. Crab stayed in the hole until her shell was thick and strong. Then she came back. She said to Crow: "That is what we should do." Crow said: "No, it takes too long. Someone might come and kill [hurt] us. There is an easier way to die. This is what we should do." He rolled his eyes, fell down backwards, and died at once.
Crab took water and poured it on him. "O, he is dead."
